Thesis: PQC is a Solana launchpad token that attests Pump.fun coins with hash-based signatures. Use flared, then stalled. At $20.5K, 99% below the $2.26M peak, it is only a cheap option on a quantum headline or a pad revival.

Good: Mint and freeze revoked, LP 100% locked. Site says 60% of revenue buys and burns $PQC; 7.18M burned with 73.5 SOL, supply down 4.33% from 1B. 30 coins pair vs PQC.
Bad: 1,159 launches, none since Nov 2. Buybacks stopped Oct 12, though the page still says hourly. Pools not live ($3.62 TVL). Creator has a rug-history flag and holds 0. Insiders ~10%. Book $14.2K. Holder counts conflict; no Bubblemaps map.
Plan: Don't chase $20.5K. Buy $14K–$18K. Stop $12K. Take profit at $35K, $65K, $150K. Keep only a tiny bottom bag if zero is acceptable.
